summary: Veradermics filed an 8-K to report the closing of an underwritten public offering of 3,843,790 shares at $100.00 per share, plus a concurrent private placement of pre-funded warrants for 300,000 shares at $99.99999 each to Suvretta Capital affiliates. Gross proceeds from the private placement were ~$30M. The pre-funded warrants have a $0.00001 exercise price, are exercisable indefinitely, and include a 9.99% beneficial ownership blocker (waivable to 19.99% on 61 days' notice). This is a routine capital raise, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
